result_carbon_help:
Location-based carbon intensity.

This value represents the average carbon intensity of the electricity grid in the region, reflecting:
• The actual energy mix of the local grid
• Regional power generation sources (coal, gas, renewables, nuclear)
• Real-time grid carbon intensity

Calculated using electricity maps API data. Lower values indicate a cleaner regional grid.
